---
name: product-scope
description: Define the next VenturaData MVP slice around EDA anomaly detection insight generation or dashboards with measurable acceptance criteria. Use when deciding what the incubation repository should implement next. Do not use when implementing an already-approved feature or claiming production readiness.
---

# Product scope

- Start from `README.md` capabilities and Beta criteria.
- Choose one reproducible dataset and one user decision the MVP should support.
- Define input schema output artifacts and measurable correctness or usefulness criteria.
- State what data sizes formats and analysis types are out of scope.
- Prefer one end-to-end analysis flow over disconnected notebook experiments.
- Require tests a reproducible dataset and documented limitations before completion.
